title: Basic Toaster
text: Basic Toaster. This is a basic toaster, but that's not a bad thing. Some products have gotten so complicated over the years, that something as simple as making toast can be difficult. You can adjust the level of brownness and other standard & basic features that toast. It feels kind of flimsy. It's especially noticeable when pressing the lever to make the toast. There was a smell the first couple of uses, but the directions said that was normal. It's decent, just not great.
